note.en: Practise controlled trunk movement as well as resisting extension, rotation and side bending. Use the hip flexors to move the thighs while the abdominal wall controls the pelvis; add difficulty gradually and allow recovery.
note.zh: 既练受控的躯干运动，也练抵抗后伸、旋转和侧弯。髋屈肌移动大腿时，腹壁配合控制骨盆；逐渐加难，并留出恢复。

title.en: One way to arrange a core session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种核心训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Prepare with a short comfortable reach and quiet breathing; keep this easy.
note.zh: 先用短而舒适的伸展热身，呼吸平缓，不做到很累。

note.en: An optional main lift for someone who has learned the hip hinge; use a light bar first. Skip it while still learning the hinge.
note.zh: 已学会髋铰链的人可以把它作为主项，先用轻杠；还在学髋铰链时可以跳过。

note.en: Practise a small controlled trunk curl without pulling on the head.
note.zh: 练小幅、有控制的躯干前屈，不拉头。

note.en: Resist the sideways cable pull on both sides; use a light load.
note.zh: 两侧都练抵抗绳索横向牵拉，选轻重量。

note.en: Choose a comfortable support and keep the waist lifted on each side.
note.zh: 选舒适的支撑版本，两侧都保持腰侧撑起。

note.en: This is a menu example, not a requirement to perform every card. Keep preparation easy, place a demanding lift before tiring trunk holds, and rest enough to regain control. Stop when position or breathing deteriorates; allow recovery before another hard session.
note.zh: 这是安排示例，不要求把全部卡片都做完。热身保持轻松；吃力的主项放在容易使躯干疲劳的支撑动作之前；休息到重新能控制动作。姿势或呼吸变差就结束，充分恢复后再进行吃力的训练。
